browser: Microsoft Edge, through the normal passenger page and local source-verified 8B route. V04 used a 390x844 viewport, U05 used 1280x850. The browser controls submitted typed requests and explicitly pressed Yes, No, any offered point and Save. Two additional unauthorized Save probes used the session API.
scope: Post-disclosure development repeats on two genuine previously published UAE sources. Tested identity clarification does not itself propose a destination. The unchanged 14-drive first-pass cohort and the six originally unseen reserve scores remain separately published. No passenger recording, personal session identifier or original photograph is included.

outcomes.explicit_parking_mark: The marked pavement was photographed parking and explicitly described as a passenger choice whose relation to the sedan could not be proved. A separately selected and saved point was inside the original visual ground polygon.
outcomes.explicit_traffic_lane: After the same affirmative vehicle reply, the lane tap returned no point, selectable option, token or Save operation.

audit: Each original normal session journal was replayed through tools/dropoff_passenger_handoff.session with the released original photo/mask and the two pinned local vehicle evidence manifests. Only action, phase, state and the source journal digest are exported. Raw local session receipts remain outside the report.
instrumentation: Before the two post-Yes physical trials, an ASCII/UTF-8 assertion in the local harness stopped two attempts after their correctly displayed first responses and before any tap. They contributed no scored physical result. The corrected harness completed both physical trials, each in a fresh session.
